Thanks for the quick replies — adding a few technical clarifications and a proposed decision-criteria mapping so your team can triage during the kickoff:

Short answers to Natalie's questions:
- Embeddings store: default approach is to persist anonymized vectors only; raw user inputs are not stored unless the customer opts in for debugging. We’ll call this out in the questionnaire.
- Deployment model: we support both VPC peering (private deployment) and hosted dedicated options. For regulated customers we typically recommend Dedicated + optional private control plane.

Proposed systems in scope (matches the spreadsheet attached):
- api.fintree.com (production backend) — model calls, request/response logging
- ingestion pipeline (kinesis -> processing lambda) — pre-processing and normalization
- embeddings store (managed vector DB) — read/write access control
- S3 logging buckets (access logs, audit) — retention & encryption settings to be confirmed
- Optional: analytics datastore (redshift) — only if you want model telemetry persisted

Decision criteria mapping (short):
- Security: SOC2 + evidence, KMS integration, audit logs (must-have)
- Privacy: PII detection & redaction, data retention policy (must-have)
- Performance: p50/p95 latency limits, autoscaling & warm-up (nice-to-have)
- Cost: per-token economics and burst capacity (procurement will care)

I attached a quick map (MAP-20260322.xlsx) with owners and who needs to approve each criterion.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll upload the completed questionnaire draft by EOD Tuesday (03/24) so you can review before the Wed call.
- Kimberly / Marissa: can you confirm if we should share a redline-friendly MSA prior to kickoff or wait for procurement?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
